complete_database_migration.rationale: Applies a prepared migration to the main branch and deletes the temporary branch.

complete_query_tuning.rationale: Applies tuning changes — typically index DDL — to the main branch.

create_branch.rationale: Creates a branch with its own compute. Billable.

delete_branch.rationale: Destroys a branch and its data.

delete_project.rationale: Destroys a project and every branch and database in it.

describe_branch.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): object tree for a branch.

explain_sql_statement.rationale: A verb that lies: framed as a diagnostic, but it takes arbitrary SQL plus an analyze flag, and EXPLAIN ANALYZE executes the statement it is given, including DML and DDL.

get_connection_string.rationale: Credential disclosure. Returns a working PostgreSQL URI for the branch's read-write compute, letting the caller perform every governed SQL operation directly, outside the bridge.

list_branch_computes.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): compute endpoints. Returns endpoint identity, not connection credentials.

list_shared_projects.rationale: Pass-through (metadata-only): projects shared with the user.

list_slow_queries.rationale: Pass-through (read): queries pg_stat_statements. Statement text can echo literal values, but it is a read and yields no reusable credential.

prepare_database_migration.rationale: Generates and executes DDL on a temporary branch it creates.

prepare_query_tuning.rationale: Creates a temporary branch and applies candidate index changes to it.

provision_neon_auth.rationale: Creates a third-party authentication integration for the project.

reset_from_parent.rationale: Discards all changes on a branch to match its parent. Data loss unless preserveUnderName is supplied.

run_sql.rationale: Executes an arbitrary SQL statement against a Neon database.

run_sql_transaction.rationale: Executes an arbitrary multi-statement SQL transaction.
